notes: Spectacular footage, but the numbers in the narration (nearly 3,000 mph, passed 2,000, 41 miles) come from on-screen readouts that the 9:16 crop cuts off and that are not quoted in facts, a fragment 'te miles' shows at 20 to 21s, the liftoff cloud shot repeats three times, and the outcome skips the real splashdown.
fixes: Facts: add source quotes from the on-screen text: the end card at source ~495 ('This video was compiled using footage obtained from booster cameras aboard shuttle flights STS-117 and STS-127' and 'Velocities shown are approximations taken from actual flight data'), the readout (e.g. '02950 mph' at ~155, '02062 mph' at ~105) and 'Altitude: 41 statute miles' at ~225. Say 'about' for speeds since NASA calls them approximations.

Line 3 ('the readout passed two thousand miles an hour'): the readout sits top right and is cropped out (only '01' shows). Use layout 'fit' for 104.0-106.5 or a crop_x of 1.0 so the mph number is readable on screen when the line says it.
Line 6 shot 228.0-230.5 crop_x 0.45 cuts 'Altitude: 41 statute miles' to 'te miles'. Use layout 'fit' so the whole line reads, or crop_x 1.0 to remove it.

Repeats: the liftoff cloud shot appears at render 0-5s (source 118-124), 16-19s (119-127) and line 9 (115.5-118). Open instead on separation, source 145.0-147.5 (motor plume with debris), which is the peak frame. Line 4 ('burned out and broke away') should show separation, 130.0-132.5 or 135.0-137.5, not liftoff.
Outcome: the booster's splashdown is visible at source 439.0-442.5 (huge white splash). Use it under 'splashed down in the ocean' instead of the gray sea-surface frames 467-476.
